purpose: Canonical authority edge map: HumanMissionAuthorization -> ... -> mission tip. Each edge: producer, consumer, canonical artifact, hash/reference, validation function, evidence.
root: ONE HumanMissionAuthorization (issuer = HUMAN, EXACT_PLAN_HASH bind, human_authorization_reference required, write-once)

edges.validation: obsidia_mission_authority_v0.verify_human_mission_authorization (issuer=HUMAN, domain tag, EXACT plan_hash vs genesis+plan, human_authorization_reference non-empty, revocations)

edges.edge: plan -> selected next action (deterministic dependency order)
edges.validation: dependency satisfaction against KEPT/snapshotted set; deterministic

edges.artifact: execution store: ExecutionEnvelope (one child per action)
edges.validation: obsidia_batch_execution.compute_execution_authority_hash (reused canonically; recomputed == stored at every boundary)

edges.edge: EAH + HMA -> DerivedActionAuthorityWitness (DAAW), NON_SOVEREIGN, per action
edges.validation: obsidia_mission_authority_v0.verify_derived_action_authority_witness (DerivedFrom h, scopeLE, EAH == eahOf env, base == mission tip); idempotence key = EXACT_RECORDED_WITNESS_MATERIAL

edges.producer: obsidia_mission_authority_pre_adapter_v0.build_derived_mission_approval_evidence (SOLE constructor; full canonical reload+reverify HMA human-root/EXACT_PLAN_HASH -> DAAW)
edges.consumer: PRE evidence adapter; C2 entry; C2 in-lock recheck; _validate_approval derived branch (via hash-bound embedded_authority_locator)
edges.validation: verify_derived_mission_approval_evidence (structural) + verify_derived_approval_with_context (full freshness incl. revocations) + verify_derived_approval_binding (exact DMAE <-> approval)

edges.consumer: obsidia_batch_execution._validate_approval ; PRE evidence adapter ; C2 governed apply
edges.artifact: execution store: approval artifact appr-<sha256[:32]>.json (os.link write-once)
edges.reference: approval_id = appr-sha256(beid:child:eah:dmae_id)[:32] ; approval_record_hash ; human_authorization_reference == HMA root
edges.validation: verify_approval_artifact (structural) + _validate_approval (envelope binding + derived branch -> canonical DMAE reload/exact-bind)

edges.reference: kx108_pre_decision_record_id + decision_record_hash ; bound to approval_id + exact EAH + PRE phase
edges.validation: verify_kx108_decision_record + phase == PRE + gate == ALLOW + EAH match + approval_id match

edges.edge: KX108_PRE ALLOW -> C2 governed mutation (the ONLY write)
edges.artifact: SealedRollbackEvidence (sre-...) built+stored+verified BEFORE write ; SealedApplyReceipt (sar-...) after
edges.validation: Stage4 path: SAME mission_id lock as revocation writer; in-lock full canonical freshness reverify (revocations reloaded) -> path reparse -> target drift double-check -> atomic_replace_with_bytes -> post-write measurement

edges.artifact: kx108 post decision store: kxpost-<...>.json (cryptographically linked to KX108_PRE + sealed evidence)
edges.reference: kx108_post_decision_record_id ; kx108_pre_decision_record_hash link ; exact EAH ; approval_id

edges.edge: KX108_POST ALLOW -> D1 disposition KEEP -> LocalSnapshotReceipt (Stage 3A)
edges.producer: obsidia_post_execution_disposition_v0 (D1 recompute) ; obsidia_mission_local_snapshot_v0.create_local_snapshot (the ONLY author of the local git commit)
edges.artifact: snapshot store: LocalSnapshotReceipt (immutable, NON_SOVEREIGN) + one local git commit of the single target
edges.validation: verify_local_snapshot_receipt (canonical, reused) ; ONLY KEEP can advance ; MISSION_SNAPSHOT_IS_FINAL_GIT_ACCEPTANCE = FALSE
only KEEP advances ; action_base_sha_i == mission_tip before action i ; canonical_base_sha immutable
edges.evidence: abc_execution_dossier.json .mission_tip_chain = [BASE, T1, T2, T3] ; witness_checks.daaw_base_is_tip_before = true for all 3
